Adds Qwen, Qwen Cloud, Model Studio, DashScope, Qwen Token Plan, Bailian Token Plan model provider support to Branch Agent.

## Distribution

- Package: `@branch/qwen-provider`
- Install route: npm or Seedbank: `clawhub:@branch/qwen-provider`

## Surface

- Providers: `qwen`, `qwencloud`, `modelstudio`, `dashscope`, `qwen-token-plan`, `bailian-token-plan`
- Contracts: `mediaUnderstandingProviders`, `videoGenerationProviders`
